answer: Who stands upon the jetty when the fleet of masks arrives? Each player must moor at a different quay and win attestations from three far harbours — no cluster may vouch for its own. One honest player stakes one ivory bond, weight 100. Ten masks split from one purse share a single quay: each earns weight 1, and each pays a copper toll that burns the moment one of them lies. The stage rewards one true face, not a chorus of copies.
